text_block_list.text:
The chime sounds.
Through the doorway comes the lively presence of horse girls pouring out of the classrooms.
choice_data_list: (Lunchtime, huh... Let's grab a bite to eat.)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good work today!
Are you heading to lunch now?
choice_data_list: Yes, though I'm not sure what to eat yet.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, in that case... I definitely recommend ramen♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, doesn't it?♪
I was actually just about to order delivery myself.
Since we're both free, would you like to join me?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
They said it'll be here in about 20 minutes.
Fufu, that's fast.
choice_data_list: Shall we relax a bit until then?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...It looks like the afternoon will be quite busy again, so I need to rest while I can.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes, very much so.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Standard duties are manageable, of course.
Everyone helps out, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: However, unexpected situations happen constantly—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a wall broke?!
Again?!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text: And the fence too... Ah, though it seems they're fixing that one themselves.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Staff B
text_block_list.text: Um, a massive shipment of training gear just arrived... addressed to the chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...She went and bought things on a whim again, didn't she?
Understood, I'll inspect the inventory.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman's Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow~. Prrrr-rr-rr♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, not there...!
Don't sharpen your claws so happily on that, bad kitty!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —And so, with all these irregularities, some tasks have spilled over into the afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, my apologies. Nothing but complaints from me.
choice_data_list: Hearing these stories makes me happy, though.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh? Truly?
choice_data_list: It just doesn't feel like something you'd usually say, Tazuna-san.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...That is true.
I suppose I don't talk about these things often.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, how strange. I usually try not to bring personal venting into the workplace... and yet.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
Delivery!
Thanks for waiting~!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, coming!
Sitting across from Tazuna-san, we slurp down the delivered ramen.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Speaking of which, I heard a new ramen shop is opening in front of the station soon.
choice_data_list: Talking about ramen while eating ramen?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, point taken!
Still, what's wrong with that? It just crossed my mind.
choice_data_list: You really are unusually candid today.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Though I'd love it if this stopped feeling unusual.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Will you keep me company for idle chats like this again?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, thank you for the meal.

Her casual demeanor vanishing, Tazuna-san straightens her posture.
Naturally, I sit up straighter too—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, let's do our best this afternoon too♪
Our days at Tracen Academy continue on—
